spheres.label: COMMAND
spheres.glimpse: Domed cockpit of reinforced crystal and dark bronze. Two forward iris viewports, shuttered. A crown of six horns, focusers dimmed. Through the crystal: a maintenance log dangling from the pilot's chair.

spheres.label: BERTHS
spheres.glimpse: Bunks through a cracked viewport. Six sleeping pods ring the chamber wall. One shows no light at all.

spheres.label: GALLEY
spheres.glimpse: A galley, dust-sealed. Cookware still racked on the walls, waiting for a crew.

spheres.label: STORES
spheres.glimpse: Storage racks in ordered rows, sealed against two centuries of decay.

spheres.label: WORKSHOP
spheres.glimpse: A workshop with tools still hanging on the walls, each on its painted outline.

spheres.label: ENGINE
spheres.glimpse: The largest segment, twice the girth of the rest. Through the reinforced glass: the core cradle, suspended in brass gyroscopic rings, and empty. The tail tapers to a drill.
